title: Dense Hub Ingest + Causal-Neighborhood Association Protocol
objective: Increase event-universe recall by consuming a dense, auditable slice of broad professional information hubs at every weekly checkpoint, while leaving v3.2 causal-neighborhood reasoning and all downstream underwriting gates unchanged.

prohibitedAtEntry: specialist commodity/technology/logistics feeds used to define the initial universe

weeklyCoverageContract.window: Since prior checkpoint through current checkpoint
weeklyCoverageContract.feedSliceRule: For each selected hub, ingest a bounded top-level business/markets/economy/technology/commodities/China-or-Asia news slice or an equivalent terminal/news-digest stream for the entire weekly window. Do not reconstruct the week by searching only event keywords.

completenessStates.complete_terminal_or_feed: The hub/feed API or archive provides an enumerable bounded slice for the entire checkpoint window and the full slice is preserved/audited.
completenessStates.bounded_digest: A professional weekly/daily digest is enumerable but narrower than a full terminal feed; its exact scope is frozen.
completenessStates.incomplete_proxy: Public-web search/archive cannot prove complete enumeration. The checkpoint may be used for exploratory diagnostics but must not be presented as complete hub coverage.
completenessStates.unavailable: The source could not be accessed; limitation is explicit and does not count toward minimum covered hub classes.

proxyRules: A search-engine reconstruction is always incomplete_proxy, even if many articles are recovered.
Do not report hub_item_recall=100% from a public proxy unless the archive itself is enumerable and bounded.
When historical full terminal feeds are unavailable, compare proxy coverage against later post-lock miss audits rather than treating absence as evidence the event did not exist.

dedupAndClustering.originRule: Mirrors of one original release/story count as one origin.
dedupAndClustering.continuationRule: Repeated coverage is continuation unless magnitude, duration, incidence, beneficiary set or causal mechanism changes materially.

causalAssociation: Unchanged from v3.2 candidate. Every event candidate receives the same bounded causal-neighborhood reasoning after hub ingestion; no new association directions are added by this version.
downstream: Unchanged V1.9/v3.2 direct exposure, event-incremental earnings/cash bridge, profit-pool state, expectation, valuation, timing, quality and adversarial gates.

missAudit.rule: A post-lock miss can diagnose the pipeline but cannot retroactively change the scored run.

acceptance.sourceLayer: Adopt dense ingest only if an untouched replication shows materially higher event recall/opportunity-week frequency and does not materially degrade downstream selection quality.
acceptance.associationLayer: v3.2 logic remains fixed during v3.3 source-layer validation.

antiOverfit: No named sector or stock can be added because it was missed in 2023.
Do not add AI, lithium, oil, memory, shipping or any other 2023 family as a mandatory search category.
The fix is coverage of the broad hub feed, not a checklist of missed themes.
2023 may motivate v3.3 but cannot validate it.
The locked 2026-09-27 forward v3.2 sample remains unchanged.
